icons.name: UmamiChase
icons.concept: One stylized shiitake mushroom, a broad gently domed cap flowing into a short stout stem. One broad crescent negative-space cut beneath the cap suggests the underside. Savory, comforting, quietly sophisticated. No gills, dots, speckles, facial features or psychedelic imagery. Warm ivory symbol on a solid deep aubergine background.

icons.name: ChompChase
icons.concept: One original, friendly chomping creature head in side profile. The outer silhouette is a compact asymmetric bean-shaped blob, NOT a perfect circle and not a fruit. A large open squared mouth cut into the right side, with two big blunt block teeth, communicates a happy chomp. Exactly one large simple circular eye. No body, limbs, antennae, ears, hair, separate food or decorative marks. This must look like its own original creature, not Pac-Man, any established mascot, or a bitten apple logo. Very bold simple shapes, readable at 40 pixels. Warm ivory head and teeth with background-color eye and mouth on a solid saturated coral-orange full-bleed square background.
